focus_areas: Regularity and physical plausibility of steam hole patterns
Consistency of metallic reflections across the curved surface
Boundary definition between the iron and the background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'perfection' of the steam holes. Real irons often have slight manufacturing variances or wear. If the holes are mathematically perfect circles with identical highlights, flag it as an artifact. Also, check if the background blur looks optical or algorithmic.
image_description: A close-up, macro shot of the soleplate of a clothes iron. The image focuses heavily on the steam holes, which appear as a dense grid of circular perforations with metallic rims. To the left, the pointed tip of the iron is visible with larger, irregularly shaped steam vents. Below the iron, there is a blurry background containing what looks like a white ceramic object (possibly an egg or stone) and some indistinct blue/teal shapes. The lighting creates strong reflections on the metallic surface.

expert_testimonies.reason: To verify if the curvature of the soleplate and the depth of the steam holes are physically consistent with the lighting and reflections.
To confirm the object is indeed an iron and not a similar-looking metallic object, given the unusual close-up perspective.
To analyze the micro-texture of the metal and steam holes for signs of AI smearing or repetitive pattern artifacts.
